scope: Broaden the existing open-source DWG/DXF comparison across versioned readers/writers, DXF projection and raw-carrier routes, downstream CAD consumer contracts, and a newly surfaced Rust-backed DWG parser; update only existing evidence gates.

method.kind: Primary-source repository, package, version-matrix, and consumer-documentation review with local plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: current peer comparison, FreeCAD consumer route, 2D compatibility gates, and deferred external-J items
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: implementation order and fast-validation cadence
method.limitations: Repository documentation and version matrices disclose intended capability, not per-entity conformance. The ezdwg source main manifest and PyPI 0.16.3 release metadata were not reconciled to an exact source revision, and no complete code-lineage audit was performed. No peer execution, independent geometry result, native acceptance, or AcDs association evidence was produced.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG documents broad DWG/DXF functionality with later DWG writer limitations; ACadSharp's published table lists DWG reading across AC1014-AC1032 and excludes AC1021 from its DWG writer matrix. These are route declarations and release-selection clues.
doesNotEstablish: per-entity correctness or complete object/reference closure
successful output in an independent native consumer
that a neighboring file version or project-reported aggregate coverage qualifies a specific feature
evidence.planUse: Keep exact peer version, file version, direction, entity/object family, diagnostics, and losses bound to each optional comparison.

evidence.observed: ezdxf exposes distinct 3D POLYLINE, polyface, MESH, and ACIS carrier interfaces. GDAL projects supported entities into OGR geometry; its opt-in raw ASM fields and 12-value transform are documented for AC1027+ DXF, while its documentation says it cannot convert ACIS bodies to OGR solids. Binary DXF input is documented from GDAL 3.12.
doesNotEstablish: exact analytic B-rep or ACIS semantic validity
equivalence of polygon/mesh projection to native MESH, POLYMESH, PFACE, or 3DSOLID identity
evidence.planUse: Reuse only at the exact DXF wire, raw-carrier, or projected-mesh stage, with every projected or omitted field reported. Keep AC1024 DWG AcDs evidence outside the GDAL AC1027+ DXF raw-carrier claim.

evidence.observed: FreeCAD's DWG route is converter-to-DXF followed by a selected DXF importer; its current C++ importer and legacy Python importer are separate routes. LibreCAD_3 documents opt-in DWG reading and deliberately absent DWG writing, with its published qualification ledger carrying read-direction claims only.
doesNotEstablish: native behavior for an unpinned application build, platform, converter, importer, or preference set
binary ABI or UI qualification from a source-compatibility build check
DWG writer qualification from successful 2D consumer compatibility
evidence.planUse: Preserve existing LibreCAD-style 2D callbacks and projection; keep typed 3D opt-in. Maintain separate source/API, ABI/rebuild, converter/importer, native UI, and DWG read/write evidence.

evidence.observed: PyPI publishes MIT-licensed ezdwg 0.16.3 wheels and describes a Rust-core, read-focused AC1012-AC1032 route with a selected high-level entity subset and an AC1015 native writer. The current GitHub core manifest has a minimal dependency list, but the reviewed PyPI metadata lacks a trusted-publishing attestation/project URL and current GitHub main reports a different package version.
doesNotEstablish: exact source/artifact correspondence without further reconciliation
complete DWG object, 3D mesh, ACIS, or AcDs coverage
independent semantic expectations or conformance from project-authored tests and a self-writer
evidence.planUse: Classify only as an optional basic-entity differential candidate. Consider a single source/artifact audit and small paired-vector comparison only if an unresolved local issue specifically benefits; do not install it in routine CI or use it for 3D/AcDs claims.

readinessRefinement: keep DWG parser, typed inventory, owner/reference closure, raw carrier, geometry semantics, and named consumer operation as separate result layers
preserve 2D LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 callbacks and legacy projection while keeping typed 3D delivery opt-in
use GDAL and ezdxf only for their exact DXF carrier or projection roles; do not treat them as B-rep/AcDs oracles
defer ezdwg to an optional pinned basic-entity differential only after release/source correspondence is audited
run no new peer executable or native consumer on the per-slice fast loop
